blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video prediction requires models to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies and to retain relevant information over long sequences. PredRNN and its successor PredRNN-V2 address this challenge with spatiotemporal Long Short-Term Memory (ST-LSTM) units that maintain two separate memory states, at the cost of a relatively complex recurrent building block. In this work, we investigate whether the simpler gating of Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can be transferred to spatiotemporal predictive learning. To this end, we develop a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit as a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM. The ST-GRU replaces the ST-LSTM's three gates per memory state with two GRU-style gates (update and reset), and merges the temporal memory state into the hidden state, which reduces the number of parameters by about 5%. We incorporate the ST-GRU into PredRNN-V2 and evaluate the resulting model on the Moving MNIST video prediction benchmark, following the original experimental protocol. Averaged over ten predicted frames, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 achieves an MSE of 55.1, an SSIM of 0.883, an LPIPS of 0.065 and a PSNR of 19.53dB. It does not surpass the original ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 on MSE, SSIM or PSNR, but it achieves a lower LPIPS and performs on par with the earlier ST-LSTM-based PredRNN, while using a simpler recurrent cell. These results suggest that ST-GRUs are a promising building block for spatiotemporal predictive learning and motivate further work on their design and integration.
blocks.zh: 视频预测需要模型来捕捉复杂的spatiotional依赖性,并保留相干信息超过长序列. PredRN及其后继者PredRN-V2以瞬间长期内存(ST-LSTM)单位来应对这一挑战,这些单位维持两个独立的内存状态,成本是相对复杂的经常性构件. 在这项工作中,我们调查是否可将更简单的Gated经常单元(GRUs)调用到spatiotal预测学习中去. 为此,我们开发出一个spatiotemporal GRU(ST-GRU)单元,作为ST-LSTM的以GRU为基础的替代品. ST-GRU将ST-LSTM每个内存状态的三个出入口替换为两个GRU风格的出入口(更新和重置),将时间内存状态合并为隐藏状态,将参数数量减少约5%. 我们把ST-GRU纳入PredRN-V2,并按照最初的实验协议,在Moving MNIST视频预测基准上评价由此产生的模型. 平均超过10个预测框架,ST-GRU基于PredRNN-V2的MSE达到55.1,SSIM为0.883,LPIPS为0.065,PSNR为19.53dB. 它在MSE,SSIM或PSNR上并没有超过原先的ST-LSTM基于PredRNN-V2,但是它实现了更低的LPIPS,并且与更早的ST-LSTM基于PredRNN的等效,同时使用更简单的经常性单元格. 这些结果表明,ST-GRU是快速预测学习的一个有希望的基石,并激励进一步开展设计和整合工作。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent developments in Artificial Intelligence (AI) have enabled the synthetic creation of images with remarkable success ( Betker et al., 2023 ) . Generating video frames, however, remains challenging, due to complex spatiotemporal dependencies within the data and uncertainty in predicting future motion ( Cai et al., 2018 ) . This task, known as predictive learning, focuses on generating future data points conditioned on data points from the past. For video, the aim is to predict upcoming frames based on a sequence of past frames.
blocks.zh: 人工智能(AI)的近期发展使得合成的图像获得了显著的成功(Betker等人,2023年). 然而,由于数据内复杂的瞬间依赖性以及预测未来运动的不确定性,产生视频帧仍然具有挑战性(Cai等人,2018年)。 这项任务被称为预测性学习,侧重于生成以过去的数据点为条件的未来数据点. 对于视频,目的是根据过去帧的顺序来预测即将到来的帧.

blocks.en: Modelling sequential data was a key motivation for developing recurrent neural networks (RNNs), which capture temporal dependencies by maintaining a hidden state over time. However, RNNs suffer from a fundamental bottleneck: the vanishing gradient problem limits their ability to retain long-term dependencies, particularly in long input sequences ( Hochreiter, 1998 ) . As a consequence, the network forgets information that is relevant for its future predictions, which reduces their accuracy.
blocks.zh: 模拟顺序数据是发展经常性神经网络(RNNs)的关键动机,这种神经网络通过长期保持隐藏状态来捕捉时间依赖性. 然而,RNNs受到一个根本的瓶颈:逐渐消失的梯度问题限制了他们保留长期依赖性的能力,特别是在长期输入序列方面(Hochreiter,1998年)。 因此,该网络忘记了与其未来预测相关的信息,从而降低了其准确性。

blocks.en: Two gated architectures were developed to alleviate this problem: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) units and Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs). The LSTM adds a memory cell controlled by three gates (an input gate, a forget gate and an output gate), which together decide what information to store, discard and expose. This allows the network to retain temporal dependencies over much longer time spans ( Hochreiter and Schmidhuber, 1997 ) . The GRU is a later development that follows the same principle of selective information retention, but simplifies the architecture: it has only an update gate and a reset gate, and no separate memory cell ( Chung et al., 2014 ) .
blocks.zh: 为缓解这一问题,开发了两座门楼: 长期短期内存(LSTM)单位和Gated经常性单位(GRU). LSTM增加了一个由三个门(输入门,忘却门和输出门)控制的内存单元格,这些门共同决定了存储,丢弃和曝光哪些信息. 这使网络能够在更长的时间内保留时间依赖性(Hochreiter和Schmidhuber,1997年)。 GRU是后期的开发,遵循了相同的选择性信息保留原则,但简化了架构:它只有更新门和重置门,没有单独的内存单元格(Chung等人,2014年).

blocks.en: LSTMs and GRUs have been widely used for modelling sequential data such as language and speech. Video prediction, however, additionally requires models to preserve spatial structure, representing both low-level appearance and high-level dynamics in order to generate future frames. Convolutional variants such as ConvLSTM ( Shi et al., 2015 ) and ConvGRU ( Ballas et al., 2016 ) address this by replacing the fully connected transformations inside the recurrent units with convolutions.
blocks.zh: LSTM和GRU被广泛用于语言和语音等相继数据的建模. 然而,视频预测还需要模型来保存空间结构,既代表低级外观,又代表高级动态,以产生未来的帧. Convolution变体,如ConvLSTM(Shi等人,2015年)和ConvGRU(Ballas等人,2016年)通过将重复单元内部完全连接的变体替换为变体来解决这个问题.

blocks.en: Building on this, Wang et al. (2017) developed the Predictive Recurrent Neural Network (PredRNN), which was later extended to PredRNN-V2 ( Wang et al., 2021 ) . Instead of classical LSTMs, PredRNN is built on spatiotemporal LSTM (ST-LSTM) units that maintain not one but two memory states. The way these ST-LSTM units are chained allows spatiotemporal information to flow both across time steps and across the layers of the network. Through this mechanism, top-down expectations and bottom-up signals are combined to predict future inputs. This differs from stacked ConvLSTMs, in which memory states are confined to individual recurrent units. PredRNN(-V2) outperformed previous architectures on several video prediction benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在此基础上,王等人(2017年)开发了预测性常年神经网络(PredRNN),后来扩展至PredRNN-V2(Wang等人,2021年). PredRN不是古典的LSTM,而是建立在spatiotemporal LSTM(ST-LSTM)单元上,这些单元维护的不是一个而是两个内存状态. 这些ST-LSTM单元的连锁方式使spatiopal信息既可以跨时间步骤流动,也可以跨网络的各个层流动. 通过这一机制,将自上而下的预期和自下而上的信号结合起来,以预测未来的投入。 这与堆叠式ConvLSTM不同,其中内存状态仅限于单个经常性单元. PredRNN(-V2)在几个视频预测基准上超过了以前的架构.

blocks.en: Although PredRNN(-V2) predicts spatiotemporal dynamics well across various datasets, its ST-LSTM units are relatively complex, with three gates per memory state and two separate memory states. GRUs, in contrast, use fewer gates than LSTMs while typically achieving comparable performance on sequential tasks ( Chung et al., 2014 ) . This work explores whether this simplification also transfers to spatiotemporal predictive learning.
blocks.zh: 虽然PredRNN(-V2)预测跨各种数据集的spatiotemporal动态良好,但其ST-LSTM单元相对复杂,每个内存状态有三个门,两个独立的内存状态. 相比之下,GRU使用的门比LSTMs少,同时通常在顺序任务上达到可比较的性能(Chung等人,2014年)。 这项工作探讨了这种简化是否也转移到瞬间预测学习。

blocks.en: To this end, we develop a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM, which we call the spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU). We replace PredRNN-V2’s ST-LSTM units with ST-GRUs and compare the resulting model with the original PredRNN-V2, as well as with several other recurrent baselines, on video frame prediction on the Moving MNIST dataset. Concurrently with our work, Dong et al. (2025) proposed a different ST-GRU cell for the original PredRNN; we include their results in our comparison and discuss how the two approaches differ. Our code is available at https://github.com/xPatta/ST-GRU .
blocks.zh: 为此,我们开发了基于GRU的ST-LSTM的替代品,我们称之为spatimporal GRU(ST-GRU). 我们用ST-GRU取代PredRN-V2的ST-LSTM单元,并将所产生的模型与原始的PredRN-V2以及其它几个经常性基线进行比较,以了解Moving MNIST数据集上的视频帧预测。 与我们的工作同时,Dong等人(2025年)为原始的PredRNN提出了一个不同的ST-GRU细胞;我们把它们的结果纳入我们的比较中,并讨论两种方法的区别. 我们的代码可见于https://github.com/xPatta/ST-GRU. 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 ST-LSTM-based PredRNN
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于ST-LSTM的PredRN

blocks.en: PredRNN ( Wang et al., 2017 ) consists of a stack of ST-LSTMs with a dual-memory mechanism that learns both the spatial structure and the temporal dynamics of sequential data, allowing it to predict future frames.
blocks.zh: PredRN(Wang et al., 2017)由一叠ST-LSTM组成,具有双模机制,既学习了相继数据的空间结构和时间动力学,又能够预测未来的帧.

blocks.en: The ST-LSTMs in PredRNN handle four flows of information: the input state 𝒳 t \mathcal{X}_{t} , the hidden state ℋ t l \mathcal{H}_{t}^{l} , and two memory states, 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} and ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} . These memory states are decoupled. The temporal memory 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} operates on a slower timescale and is designed to learn long-term dependencies in the data. It is passed horizontally from time step t − 1 t-1 to time step t t within the same layer l l . The spatiotemporal memory ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} , in contrast, adapts more rapidly to changes in the input and captures short-term dynamics. It follows a deeper transition path that zigzags upwards, passing information from layer l − 1 l-1 to layer l l within the same time step; only the top layer at time step t − 1 t-1 is connected to the bottom layer at time step t t .

The input gate, with a sigmoid activation ( σ \sigma ), determines how much new information from the current input is added to the memory. The forget gate decides what information is discarded. The input modulation gate generates candidate values using the hyperbolic tangent ( tanh \tanh ); these are scaled by the input gate as i t ⊙ g t i_{t}\odot g_{t} and added to the memory state, replacing the forgotten information.

blocks.en: 2.2 ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于ST-LSTM的PredRN-V2

blocks.en: PredRNN-V2 ( Wang et al., 2021 ) extends PredRNN in three ways. First, a decoupling loss explicitly increases the distance between the updates of the two memory states in latent space, encouraging them to learn different aspects of the spatiotemporal variations and preventing redundant features. Second, reverse scheduled sampling is a curriculum learning strategy for the encoder that gradually shifts its input from the model’s own predictions to the ground-truth frames, which forces the model to learn long-term dynamics. Third, PredRNN-V2 supports action-conditioned video prediction.
blocks.zh: PredRNN-V2(Wang et al., 2021)以三种方式延伸PredRN. 首先,脱钩损失明确增加了两个内存状态在潜在空间的更新距离,鼓励他们学习瞬间变化的不同方面,并防止冗余特征. 其次,逆向计划取样是编码器的课程学习策略,它逐渐将输入从模型自己的预测转向地面真实框架,这迫使模型学习长期动态. 第三,PredRNN-V2支持动作有条件的视频预测.

blocks.en: 2.3 ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2
blocks.zh: 2.3 基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2

blocks.en: We propose a variant of PredRNN-V2 in which the ST-LSTM building blocks are replaced by GRU-based counterparts, which we call ST-GRUs. We design the ST-GRU around the key characteristics of a GRU, while keeping the separation between temporal and spatiotemporal memory flows of the ST-LSTM ( Wang et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PredRNN-V2的变体,其中ST-LSTM的构件被基于GRU的对应方所取代,我们称之为ST-GRUs. 我们围绕GRU的关键特征设计ST-GRU,同时保持ST-LSTM的时间和瞬间记忆流的分离(Wang等人,2017年;Wang等人,2021年).

blocks.en: Following the GRU, each memory update in the ST-GRU uses only two gates: an update gate z t z_{t} (respectively z t ′ z^{\prime}_{t} ) and a reset gate r t r_{t} (respectively r t ′ r^{\prime}_{t} ). In addition, the ST-GRU omits the separate temporal memory state 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} and integrates its function into the hidden state ℋ t l \mathcal{H}_{t}^{l} , since both follow the same horizontal path from one time step to the next.
blocks.zh: ST-GRU之后,ST-GRU中的每个内存更新都只使用两个门:一个更新门 z t z t}(分别是z t z^{\prime}_{t})和一个重置门 r r_{t}(分别是r t r^{\prime}_{t}). 此外,ST-GRU省略了单独的时间记忆状态 C t l\ mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} 并将其功能整合到隐藏状态 H t l\ mathcal{ H}_{t}^{l}],因为两者从一个步骤到下一个步骤都遵循相同的水平路径.

blocks.en: As a result, the two pairs of gates act on ℋ t l \mathcal{H}_{t}^{l} and ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} , rather than on 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} and ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} as in the ST-LSTM. The update gate z t z_{t} decides how much of the state is replaced by new content, whereas the reset gate r t r_{t} decides how much of the previous state is used when computing that new content. Together they play roles similar to the input and forget gates of the ST-LSTM ( Chung et al., 2014 ) . The gates of both states share the convolutions applied to ℳ t l − 1 \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l-1} , which further reduces the number of parameters. The gates are used to compute the candidate states ℋ ~ t l \widetilde{\mathcal{H}}_{t}^{l} and ℳ ~ t l \widetilde{\mathcal{M}}_{t}^{l} , which then produce the new hidden state ℋ t l \mathcal{H}_{t}^{l} indirectly via the output gate o t o_{t} , and directly via concatenation, a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution and a tanh \tanh . The ST-GRU equations are given in Figure 4(b) , and schematics of the cell and its integration in PredRNN(-V2) are shown in Figures 5(b) and 6(b) (Appendix A ), next to their ST-LSTM counterparts. The figures highlight both what the two cells share (the decoupled spatiotemporal memory) and where they differ (the number of gates and memory states).

blocks.en: 2.4 Implementation
blocks.zh: 2.4 执行情况

blocks.en: We implemented the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 on top of the official PyTorch implementation of PredRNN-V2 ( Wu, 2022 ) . Following the structure of the original ST-LSTM cell, we implemented the ST-GRU as designed in Section 2.3 , with two instead of three gates per memory state and without using 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} . The variable for 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} is retained in the code only to keep the interface compatible with PredRNN-V2. We then built a version of PredRNN-V2 that uses the ST-GRU as its building block, passing information through ST-GRUs instead of ST-LSTMs. Because the ST-GRU has no temporal memory update to decouple from ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} , we trained this model without PredRNN-V2’s decoupling loss, using only the MSE loss; reverse scheduled sampling was kept unchanged. All other settings follow the official Moving MNIST configuration: four recurrent layers with 128 hidden channels each, 5 × 5 5\times 5 convolutions, a patch size of 4, a batch size of 8 and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . With these settings, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 has 22.6M parameters, compared with 23.9M for the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2, a reduction of about 5%. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/xPatta/ST-GRU .
blocks.zh: 我们实施了基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2,在PredRN-V2(吴,2022年)的官方PyTorch执行之上. 按照原ST-LSTM细胞的结构,我们执行了2.3节设计的ST-GRU,每个内存状态有两个而不是三个门,并且没有使用C t l\mathcal{C}_{t}^{l}. Ct l\ mathcal{C}_{t}^{l}的变量保留在代码中,只是为了保持接口与PredRNN-V2兼容. 随后我们建造了PredRNN-V2的版本,以ST-GRU作为其构件,通过ST-GRU而不是ST-LSTM传递信息. 由于ST-GRU没有时间记忆更新可以与Mt l\mathcal{M}_{t}^{l}解开,我们训练了这个模型,没有PredRN-V2的解钩损失,只使用MSE损失;反向计划采样没有改变. 所有其他设置都遵循了官方的Moving MNIST配置:四个经常层各有128个隐藏通道,5×5 5\ 5 5 turns 4,批量大小为8,学习速率为10−4 10×4}. 在这些设置下,ST-GRU基于PredRN-V2的参数为22.6M,而ST-LSTM基于PredRN-V2的参数为23.9M,减少了约5%. 我们的执行情况可查阅https://github.com/xPatta/ST-GRU。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2.5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 2.5 实验设置

blocks.en: To compare the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 directly with the original ST-LSTM-based version, we repeated the Moving MNIST experiment of Wang et al. (2021) , following the same training and testing protocol. Specifically, we trained the model for 80,000 iterations using the official training configuration ( Wu, 2022 ) , and evaluated it with four metrics: mean squared error (MSE), structural similarity index measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR).
blocks.zh: 为了直接将ST-GRU基于PredRN-V2的PredRN-V2与最初的ST-LSTM版本进行比较,我们重复了Wang等人(2021年)的Moving MNIST实验,遵循同样的训练和测试协议. 具体来说,我们使用正式训练配置(Wu, 2022)训练了80,000次迭代的模型,并用四个度量标准进行了评价:平均平方误差(MSE),结构相似指数度量(SSIM)(Wang等人,2004年),学习透视图像补丁相似度(LPIPS)(Zhang等人,2018年),高峰信号对噪比(PSNR).

blocks.en: We further compared our model with several other recurrent models. ConvLSTM ( Shi et al., 2015 ) and ConvGRU ( Ballas et al., 2016 ) are convolutional LSTM- and GRU-based RNNs without decoupled spatiotemporal memory. The ST-LSTM-based PredRNN ( Wang et al., 2017 ) has decoupled spatiotemporal memory but without the V2 additions (see Section 2.2 ). Finally, Dong et al. (2025) concurrently proposed an ST-GRU cell and integrated it into PredRNN. Because they evaluated it with the same experimental protocol as above, we include their reported results in our comparison. We emphasise that their ST-GRU-based PredRNN differs from our ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 both in the design of the ST-GRU cell and in the absence of the V2 additions (see Section 2.2 ). Results for the LSTM-based baselines are taken from Wang et al. (2021) , and those for the GRU-based baselines from Dong et al. (2025) . PSNR is not reported in these sources, so we computed it for the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 using the official trained model ( Wu, 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们进一步将我们的模型与其他几个经常模型进行比较。 ConvLSTM(Shi等人,2015年)和ConvGRU(Ballas等人,2016年)是革命性LSTM和GRU基的RNNs,没有脱钩的spatiotemporary记忆. 基于ST-LSTM的PredRNN(Wang et al., 2017)已经脱钩了spatiotopal memory,但没有V2加法(见第2.2节). 终于董等. (2025年)同时提出ST-GRU细胞,并将其并入PredRN. 因为他们用与上述相同的实验程序来评估,我们把报告的结果纳入我们的比较。 我们强调,它们在ST-GRU基础上的PredRN与我们在ST-GRU基础上的PredRN-V2在ST-GRU细胞设计和没有V2加法的情况下都有所不同(见第2.2节)。 基于LSTTM的基准结果来自Wang等人(2021年),基于GRU的基准结果来自Dong等人(2025年)。 PSNR没有在这些来源中报告,所以我们用经过正式训练的模型(Wu, 2022年)来计算ST-LSTM基于PredRNN-V2的.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , all four frame-wise metrics (MSE, SSIM, LPIPS and PSNR) plateau within the 80,000 training iterations, indicating that the number of iterations was sufficient for convergence. Early frames are consistently predicted more accurately than later frames. This is expected, as early frames are temporally closer to the input sequence and are therefore inherently easier to predict.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,在80,000次培训迭代中,所有四个框架计量标准(MSE、SSIM、LPIPS和PSNR)的高原,表明迭代的数量足以趋同。 早期帧的预测比后期帧更准确. 由于早期框架在时间上更接近输入序列,因此在本质上更容易预测,因此这是预期的.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Frame-wise metrics (MSE, SSIM, LPIPS, PSNR) of the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 on the Moving MNIST test set over 80,000 training iterations. The frame number indicates the number of time steps between the predicted frame and the last observed frame.
blocks.zh: 图1:在移动的MNIST测试中,ST-GRU基于PredRNN-V2的帧度量衡(MSE,SSIM,LPIPS,PSNR)设置了80,000多个培训迭代. 帧数表示预测帧与最后观测帧之间的时间步数.

blocks.en: Visual inspection of the generated frames confirms that the model predicts earlier frames (i.e., frames closer to the input frames) more accurately (Figure 3 ). Local image features degrade gradually in later frames, especially when the trajectories of the two digits overlap.
blocks.zh: 对生成的帧的视觉检查证实,模型预测更早的帧(即更接近输入帧的帧)更准确(图3). 局部图像特征在后来的帧中逐渐降解,特别是在两位数字的轨迹重叠时.

blocks.en: 3.1 Quantitative Model Comparison
blocks.zh: 3.1 数量模型比较

blocks.en: Table 1 summarises the performance of all models in terms of MSE, SSIM, LPIPS and PSNR, averaged over the ten predicted frames. On MSE and SSIM, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 performs on par with the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN (MSE 55.1 vs. 56.8; SSIM 0.883 vs. 0.867). It clearly outperforms ConvLSTM on all metrics, and ConvGRU on SSIM and LPIPS, while its MSE is only slightly lower than that of ConvGRU. The ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 and the ST-GRU-based PredRNN of Dong et al. (2025) achieve better MSE and SSIM than our model. On LPIPS, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 does outperform the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 (0.065 vs. 0.071), and is surpassed only by the ST-GRU-based PredRNN (0.057). On PSNR, which we computed only for the two PredRNN-V2 variants, the ST-LSTM-based model scores higher (20.05 vs. 19.53 dB).
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了所有模型在MSE,SSIM,LPIPS和PSNR方面的性能,平均为10个预测框架. 在MSE和SSIM上,基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2与基于ST-LSTM的PredRN(MSE 55.1 vs 56.8;SSIM 0.883 vs. 0.867)的PredRN等效. 它在所有度量衡上明显优于ConvLSTM,在SSIM和LPIPS上则优于ConvGRU,而它的MSE只略低于ConvGRU. 以ST-LSTM为基础的PredRN-V2和以ST-GRU为基础的Dong等人的PredRNN. (2025年)比我们的模型实现更好的MSE和SSIM. 在LPIPS上,基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2确实超过了基于ST-LSTM的PredRN-V2(0.065 vs. 0.071),并且仅被基于ST-GRU的PredRN(0.057)超越. 在PSNR上,我们只计算了两个PredRNN-V2变体,基于ST-LSTM的模型得分较高(20.05 vs 19.53 dB).

Results for the LSTM-based baselines are taken from Wang et al. (2021) and for the GRU-based baselines from Dong et al. (2025) . PSNR (in dB) was computed only for the two PredRNN-V2 variants.
blocks.zh: 表1:移动MNIST测试集的模型性能. 所有度量衡均值为10个预测框架。 每个度量的最好结果用粗体表示,我们的模型用粗体表示。 基于LSTTM的基线结果取自Wang等人(2021年)和基于GRU的基线取自Dong等人(2025年)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Frame-wise MSE, SSIM, LPIPS and PSNR on the Moving MNIST test set. All models were trained and evaluated following the protocol described in Section 2.5 . Results for the LSTM-based models are taken from Wang et al. (2021) , and those for the GRU-based models from Dong et al. (2025) . PSNR for the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 was computed with the official trained model ( Wu, 2022 ) . All results for the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 are from our own evaluation.
blocks.zh: 图2:在移动的MNIST测试集上采用框架式MSE,SSIM,LPIPS和PSNR. 所有型号都按照第2.5节所述协议进行了培训和评价。 基于LSTM的模型的结果来自Wang等人(2021年),基于GRU的模型的结果来自Dong等人(2025年). ST-LSTM基于PredRNN-V2的PSNR是用官方训练的模型(Wu, 2022)计算出来的. 基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2的所有结果来自我们自己的评价.

blocks.en: The frame-wise results in Figure 2 agree with these averages. In MSE and SSIM, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 closely tracks the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN across all ten frames. Frame-wise LPIPS is only available for the LSTM-based baselines; compared with these, our model achieves the lowest LPIPS, and its advantage over the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 grows for later frames. In PSNR, the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 is consistently higher, in line with Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 图2的帧结果与这些平均数一致。 在MSE和SSIM中,基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2紧密跟踪基于ST-LSTM的PredRN,跨越所有十个框架. 框架式的LPIPS只可用于基于LSTM的基线;与之相比,我们的模型实现了最低的LPIPS,它相对于基于ST-LSTM的PredRNN-V2的优势为后期帧增长. 在PSNR中,基于ST-LSTM的PredRNN-V2一直较高,与表1一致.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Replacing the ST-LSTM with our ST-GRU in PredRNN-V2 yields a model that performs well across metrics and frames, but that is generally outperformed by the original ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2. We believe this is largely due to how the improvements that define PredRNN-V2 interact with our design. The decoupling loss acts on the two separate memory states 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} and ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} . Because the ST-GRU does not use 𝒞 t l \mathcal{C}_{t}^{l} , this loss cannot be applied in its original form, and we trained the ST-GRU-based model without it. As our experiments did not involve action-conditioned video prediction, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 therefore benefits mainly from reverse scheduled sampling, whereas the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 benefits from both reverse scheduled sampling and the decoupling loss. Our results suggest that the simplified cell does not compensate for the loss of this mechanism. Adapting the decoupling loss to act between ℋ t l \mathcal{H}_{t}^{l} and ℳ t l \mathcal{M}_{t}^{l} is therefore a natural next step.
blocks.zh: 用我们位于PredRNN-V2的ST-GRU取代ST-LSTM产生一个跨度量和帧性能良好的模型,但一般被最初基于ST-LSTM的PredRNN-V2. 我们认为,这主要是由于界定PredRNN-V2的改进如何与我们的设计相互作用。 脱钩损失在两个独立的内存上发生C t l\ mathcal{C}_{t}^{l}和M t l\mathcal{M}_{t}^{l}. 因为ST-GRU没有使用C t \ mathcal{C}_{t}^{l},所以这种损失不能以原始形式应用,我们没有它就训练了ST-GRU的模型. 由于我们的实验不涉及有动作条件的视频预测,因此ST-GRU的PredRN-V2主要受益于逆序采样,而ST-LSTM的PredRN-V2则受益于逆序采样和脱钩损失. 我们的结果表明,简化的单元格不能弥补这一机制的损失。 Ht l\ mathcal{H}_{t}^{l}和Mt l\mathcal{M}_{t}^{l}之间的脱钩损失因此是自然的下一步.

blocks.en: Interestingly, our model achieves a lower LPIPS than the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2, especially for later frames. LPIPS measures distance in the feature space of a pretrained deep network and is designed to reflect human judgements of perceptual similarity ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . This suggests that the ST-GRU-based model preserves perceptually relevant structure better, even when its pixel-wise error is higher.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,我们的模型实现了比基于ST-LSTM的PredRNN-V2更低的LPIPS,特别是对于后来的帧. LPIPS在预训深网的特征空间中测量距离,旨在反映人类对知觉相似性的判断(张等人,2018年). 这表明基于ST-GRU的模型更好地保存了感知相关的结构,即使它的像素偏差更高.

blocks.en: The concurrent ST-GRU-based PredRNN of Dong et al. (2025) outperforms our model on all reported metrics, even though it does not use the PredRNN-V2 improvements. This indicates that the specific design of the gated cell matters at least as much as these training improvements. Nevertheless, our ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 performs on par with the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN while using a simpler building block. Comparing the two ST-GRU designs under identical conditions, and combining the stronger cell with the PredRNN-V2 training scheme, are promising directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 以ST-GRU为基础的同时的Dong等人的PredRNN。 (2025年)虽然没有使用PredRNN-V2改进,但在所有已报告的度量标准上,我们的模型都超过了我们的性能. 这表明大门牢房的具体设计至少与这些培训改进一样重要。 尽管如此,我们的ST-GRU基于PredRN-V2在使用一个更简单的构件的同时,与ST-LSTM基于PredRN的PredRN同样发挥. 比较两个ST-GRU在相同条件下的设计,以及将更强大的细胞与PredRNN-V2培训计划相结合,是未来工作的有希望的方向.

blocks.en: We evaluated our model only on Moving MNIST, a synthetic benchmark; experiments on more complex, real-world datasets are needed to establish how well the ST-GRU generalises. We report results from a single training run. Results for the baselines are taken from the literature rather than re-trained under identical conditions. Finally, the ST-GRU reduces the parameter count by only about 5%, and we did not measure training time, inference time or memory use, so its practical computational benefits remain to be quantified.
blocks.zh: 我们只评估了综合基准MNIST的移动模型;需要实验更复杂、更现实的数据集,以确定ST-GRU的一般情况。 我们报告一次培训的结果。 基线的结果取自文献,而不是在同样条件下重新培训。 最后,ST-GRU只将参数数减少约5%,我们没有衡量训练时间,推断时间或内存使用,所以其实际的计算效益仍有待量化.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Predictions of the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 on five Moving MNIST test sequences, showing the input sequence, the ground-truth future sequence and the predicted future sequence. Both global and local similarity to the ground truth decline for frames further into the future.
blocks.zh: 图3:关于五个移动 MNIST测试序列的ST-GRU基于PredRNN-V2的预测,显示输入序列,地面真实未来序列和预测未来序列. 无论是全球还是地方,都与未来框架的地面真相下降相似。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2, a reformulation of PredRNN-V2 ( Wang et al., 2021 ) that replaces its ST-LSTM building blocks with a newly designed ST-GRU cell. The ST-GRU keeps the decoupled spatiotemporal memory flow of the ST-LSTM, but uses fewer gates, one fewer memory state and about 5% fewer parameters. On Moving MNIST, the model successfully captures the spatiotemporal dynamics of ten-frame future sequences, with accuracy decreasing for later frames, as expected. It performs on par with the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN ( Wang et al., 2017 ) and achieves a lower LPIPS than the ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2, although it remains behind PredRNN-V2 on pixel-level metrics. We expect that adapting PredRNN-V2’s decoupling loss to the ST-GRU will close part of this gap.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了基于ST-GRU的PredRN-V2,是PredRN-V2(Wang等人,2021年)的重制版,用新设计的ST-GRU电池取代其ST-LSTM的构件. ST-GRU保持了ST-LSTM的脱钩的spatiotopal内存流,但使用了更少的门,一个更少的内存状态和大约5%的参数. 在Moving MNIST上,该模型成功捕捉到十帧未来序列的瞬间动态,如预期,后帧的精度下降. 它与基于ST-LSTM的PredRN(Wang et al., 2017)的PredRN(英语:PredRNN)等效,并实现了低于基于ST-LSTM的PredRNN-V2的LPIPS,尽管它在像素级的度量上仍然落后于PredRNN-V2. 我们期望,将PredRNN-V2的脱钩损失与ST-GRU的脱钩将缩小这一差距的一部分。
